plainEnglish.summary: Text meets a minimum contrast against its background. The contrast measure is still to be determined in the draft. Exceptions include inactive controls, pure decoration, invisible text, text in pictures with significant other visual content, logos, and text that also appears elsewhere on the page in a form that meets the requirement.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Low-contrast text is hard or impossible to read for people with low vision, and for anyone in bright light.
